Ava (Marketing): Quick preflight — t-minus ~12h to the public announce. Need final signoff on changelog links, docs permalinks, and webinar promo copy. Who can confirm docs URLs are ready? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jordan (Eng): Docs are published but I want to lock one small line in the changelog (breaking runtime flag). Sending the exact snippet now.
Jordan (Eng): ```
Changelog v2.1.0 — highlights:
- Added adaptive batching defaults to reduce per-token latency by ~15%
- New runtime flag: `--kv-cache-strict` (default: off). Enable for deterministic caching; may increase peak memory
- Fixed rare panics on long-sequence decode paths
```
Ava (Marketing): Thanks. Can you paste the permalink to that changelog entry? We need to embed it in the launch post and the press kit.
Jordan (Eng): Permalink: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/changelog/v2.1.0#kv-cache-strict. Also pushed a short note in /release/notes with a one-paragraph explainer for non-engineers.
Priya (Product): I'll review the explainer and trim if needed for the tweet thread. Also: webinar slot confirmed at 9am PT tomorrow — link below. Can marketing use that in the hero CTA?
Ava (Marketing): Yes, using CTA: "Join our lunch-and-learn 9am PT — demo + benchmarks". Need final lead-routing path for webinar signups (Sales Ops). @Maya?
Maya (Sales Ops): Route webinar signups into SFDC campaign "Launch_2_1_Webinar" and mark MQL if attended. Also set utm_source=announce_email for the registration link. I'll add a short automation to tag dedicated trial leads.
Sam (DevEx): Small ask from docs: can we add an example of the new flag in the quickstart so users see the tradeoff? I'll PR a 2-line snippet now.
Jordan (Eng): On it, Sam. I'll review and merge early morning. No runtime changes required for the hosted rollout — just customer docs.
Ava (Marketing): Final checklist for release post: changelog permalink (confirmed), docs quickstart snippet (Sam->Jordan), webinar CTA (Priya + Maya routing), assets (design has hero + benchmark chart). Anyone blocking the announce? :thinking_face:
Maya (Sales Ops): No blocks from my side. Automation tested in staging.
DeployBot: Canary rollout started on dedicated pool (canary-1) at 1715701300. Observability hooks active.
Jordan (Eng): Canary looks healthy so far — latency within SLOs. If we see tail latency increase >10% we'll pause and fallback to v2.0.
Ava (Marketing): Great — I'll queue the publish at 09:00 PT. If anything changes ping here and add the short reason. Meeting to sync in 30m for any last-minute copy changes. :white_check_mark:
